targets.title: NEVER BREAK YOUR TRADING RULES! ❤️ Even After 10 Losses!
targets.author: Infinity trading Academy FX
targets.text:
NEVER BREAK YOUR TRADING RULES! ❤️ | Trading Psychology

Trading Discipline is what separates emotional decisions from planned trading decisions.

Jab aap trading seekhte ho, toh sabse pehle apne rules aur trading plan ko samajhna zaroori hai.

Market mein losses honge, winning streaks bhi aayengi, lekin apne emotions ke according trading rules change karna dangerous ho sakta hai.

Remember these important trading lessons:

🎯 Always follow your trading plan.
🧠 Control Fear, Greed and FOMO.
🛡️ Never ignore Risk Management.
📊 Review your trading performance.
⏳ Be patient and disciplined.
